title: Multi-element global J2 plasticity patch
purpose: Ensure that the verified radial-return map and consistent tangent remain correct when consumed by global multi-element equilibrium, regional quadrature state, prescribed-displacement work, and result assembly.
physics: three-dimensional small-strain rate-independent J2 plasticity with linear isotropic hardening
reference: Analytical homogeneous uniaxial hardening path and agentfem.benchmark.j2_global_restart Golden quantities

execution.evidence: A multi-cell displacement-controlled cube must reproduce the versioned homogeneous uniaxial hardening response while retaining committed quadrature state and energy/work closure.

observables: Mean axial Cauchy stress over the constitutive quadrature.
Mean and range of committed equivalent plastic strain.
Accepted-increment reaction work and internal-energy components.
acceptance: Mean axial stress and equivalent plastic strain satisfy the versioned analytical Golden tolerances.
Equivalent plastic strain is uniform across more than ten quadrature points.
Every integration point enters the plastic state at the final prescribed displacement.
Generalized-reaction external work closes against elastic, hardening, and dissipated internal energy within the declared path tolerance.
limitations: The current global J2 provider is serial, single-material, three-dimensional, small-strain, and isotropic-hardening only.
This patch is a necessary assembly test; a notched structural benchmark and portable distributed quadrature restart remain separate promotion gates.
